title: Veil and Garden Again
premise: Kestrel Thackeray's ledgers record every impossible thing the Veiled Guild has bought, sold, or buried — until prayers meant for long-dead gods start arriving at her desk with answers attached. Tracing the miracle-trade to the Guild's masked master, she discovers the thirteenth moon is a door the old gods are prying open, and the secret in her own blood is the key that locks it. Hunted by the Guild, courted by desperate gods, and sheltered by a found family of debt-runners and defrocked priests, Kestrel must choose between exposing the truth and becoming the sacrifice the law demands. In the end she burns the ledgers, seals the door with her own name instead of her blood, and walks free into a city learning to govern itself without gods or guilds.
about_author: Noor Amberdale is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing confiscated grimoires before turning to fiction. She writes from a cluttered study full of unlabeled keys and insists every debt in her stories must be paid.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Small Miracles
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. She balances the Guild's books and finds a prayer answered for a dying child — logged as a purchase, priced in blood. Emotional beat: quiet dread beneath routine; the first crack in her obedient world.

chapters.title: Thirteenth Turn Rising
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. The moon shows a faint thirteenth sliver no almanac explains; the Guild's masked Master summons her to copy a sealed codex. Emotional beat: fascination curdling into fear as she glimpses her own name in the codex.

chapters.title: Debt-Bound
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. Flashback woven in: how her family's debt bound her to the Guild, and why her grandmother's death was recorded as an 'asset transfer.' Emotional beat: grief sharpened into resolve.

chapters.title: The Debt-Runner's Oath
chapters.summary: Bramble's POV. A cheerful smuggler of forgiven debts, Bramble catches Kestrel copying forbidden pages and, instead of reporting her, offers shelter with his crew. Emotional beat: wary first trust; found family's door opening.

chapters.title: Gods in the Gutter
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. In the low city, a shrine to a forgotten god weeps real wine; worshippers whisper that the old gods are 'answering again.' Emotional beat: awe mixed with the horror of watching faith become currency.

chapters.title: The Masked Master's Bargain
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. The Master reveals he knows she copied the codex and offers freedom in exchange for her blood at the moon's thirteenth turn. Emotional beat: the trap of hope; she agrees to buy time.

chapters.title: What the Priest Buried
chapters.summary: Sister Ovel's POV. A defrocked priest hiding with Bramble's crew confesses she helped seal the gods away a generation ago — and that Kestrel's grandmother was the last door-keeper. Emotional beat: guilt passed down like an inheritance.

chapters.title: Blood in the Margins
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. Testing her grandmother's notes, Kestrel's blood opens a locked page: she is a door-keeper's heir. Emotional beat: identity upended; the secret that could reignite the war is hers.

chapters.title: The Guild's Impossible Market
chapters.summary: Bramble's POV. The crew infiltrates the Guild's night market where miracles are auctioned; they witness a god's fragment sold to a magistrate. Emotional beat: outrage; justice outside the law begins to take shape.

chapters.title: A Prayer with Teeth
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. An old god answers her unwilling prayer, offering to erase her debt in exchange for the codex. Emotional beat: temptation and the first taste of power's corruption.

chapters.title: The Crew Divided
chapters.summary: Ovel's POV. The found family fractures: Bramble wants to sell the codex, Ovel wants to destroy it, Kestrel wants to use it. Emotional beat: bitter argument; love strained by principle.

chapters.title: Arrest at the Weighhouse
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. The Guild brands her a thief using lawful warrants; she is arrested publicly, and the crowd that loved her ledgers turns away. Emotional beat: betrayal by the law she once served.

chapters.title: The Long Cell
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. Imprisoned, she bargains with the imprisoned god-fragment in the cell below, learning the war's true origin: the gods were sealed to stop a massacre, not a rebellion. Emotional beat: moral vertigo; no clean side.

chapters.title: Break the Chain
chapters.summary: Bramble's POV. The crew executes a reckless rescue through the Guild's waterways, Bramble paying a debt with his own freedom. Emotional beat: sacrifice; the found family chooses each other over safety.

chapters.title: The Master Unmasked
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. The Master is revealed as the first door-keeper's failed heir, sustained for centuries by traded miracles. Emotional beat: pity and revulsion; a mirror of what Kestrel could become.

chapters.title: Moonrise, Turn Twelve
chapters.summary: Ovel's POV. With one turn left, the old gods mass at the city's edge; Ovel chooses to break her oath and teach Kestrel the sealing rite. Emotional beat: redemption offered, not guaranteed.

chapters.title: The Price of Names
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. The rite demands a door-keeper's blood; Kestrel secretly prepares to give it, hiding her plan behind forged ledgers. Emotional beat: quiet, terrible resolve; the lie that protects the people she loves.

chapters.title: The Guild Falls
chapters.summary: Bramble's POV. The crew and the debt-runners storm the Guild as the gods breach the walls; the Master offers Kestrel the throne of miracle-broker. Emotional beat: chaos, temptation, refusal.

chapters.title: Thirteenth Turn
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. At the moon's full impossible phase, Kestrel reaches the door and discovers blood alone won't close it — only a freely surrendered name. Emotional beat: climax; terror transmuted into clarity.

chapters.title: The Unwritten
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. She gives her name to the door, unbinding her debt, her bloodline's burden, and the gods' claim at once; the war gutters out unlit. Emotional beat: dissolution and peace; she becomes no one, and thereby free.

chapters.title: Ledgers Burned
chapters.summary: Bramble's POV. The crew burns the Guild's records, freeing ten thousand debt-bound souls; Bramble mourns and celebrates a Kestrel who no longer remembers being theirs. Emotional beat: bittersweet victory; justice outside the law, paid in full.

chapters.title: A Garden Without a Veil
chapters.summary: Kestrel's POV. Living nameless in the low city, Kestrel tends a garden on the Guild's ruins; a child asks her name and she smiles. Emotional beat: gentle resolution — identity rebuilt from choice, not debt.
